title: Immediate response to a manual SOS
disclaimer: Emergency guidance only - not a diagnosis or a substitute for professional care. Call the local emergency number, follow the dispatcher, and provide care only within your training.

sources.title: First Aid for an Unresponsive and Breathing Person

steps.title: Check the scene
steps.instruction: Pause and make sure the area is safe for you, the person, and anyone helping before you approach.

steps.title: Check the person
steps.instruction: Check responsiveness, normal breathing, and life-threatening bleeding, and look for an obvious immediate danger.

steps.title: Summon emergency help
steps.instruction: Call the local emergency number, send someone for an AED, state that a manual SOS was activated, and follow the dispatcher's instructions.

steps.title: Use CPR and an AED when needed
steps.instruction: If the person is unresponsive and not breathing normally, begin CPR and use the AED as soon as available, within your training and following its prompts.

steps.title: Give trained first aid
steps.instruction: If the person is responsive, ask what happened, obtain consent when possible, and provide only the first aid you are trained to give.

steps.title: Monitor and hand off
steps.instruction: Stay with the person and keep checking responsiveness and breathing until professional help arrives and takes over.
